name: D07_3_power_4_creature_entering_under_my_control_draws
notes: Printed: 'Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.' With the Uprising in play: my 3/3 entering draws nothing; my 4/4 entering draws one card; the opponent's 5/5 entering under their control draws nothing for anyone (seat 0 has 1 card in hand and the opponent has none). The 4/4 is exactly the one that drew.
